sources.use: CONNECT is startup-only; object/PUBLIC privileges, owners and effective grant paths must be audited.
Superuser/CREATEROLE authority and role defaults are not least-privilege enforcement.
NOINHERIT alone does not remove SET ROLE paths.
Ordered exact authentication rules; include local/TCP/IPv4/IPv6 paths.
TLS client certificate can bind certificate subject to requested role.
Server certificate chain/name verification; pg Node implementation options must be accepted separately.
Per-relation lock acquisition, transaction release and explicit LOCK privilege requirements.
Read-only transaction characteristic; default may be overridden.
Privileged function execution and security-definer review obligation.
RLS is per-row authorization, not admission or TRUNCATE protection.
setTargetTable obtains RowExclusiveLock before recording executor requiredPerms.
InitPlan/ExecCheckRTPerms permission checks; supports inference about transient parse-stage RX.
Host/same-network reachability and published ports; network alone is not authentication.
Per-service secret file mounts; not protection from host/Docker administrator.

sourceInference: An authenticated readonly outside client can acquire transient automatic RX before ACL denial; therefore no external authenticated session is part of the strict proof.
